positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Aided students working in teams to program small autonomous vehicles (Raspberry Pi platform, running Robot OS & Ubuntu) using Python.
- Serviced various hardware and software bugs
- Focused on image capture, simplified lane following to navigate a scaled-down city track

company.name: Autonomous Navigation Workshop at Hunter College

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
A lab that explores and experiments with computer vision and image recognition
- Trained, tested and analyzed a convolutional neural network for semantic segmentation of vehicles in street scenes
- Created and modified Python programs to convert 3D image data into a usable form
- Researched cutting edge developments in computer vision

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
A website that promotes and explains sustainability initiatives in New York City.
- Developed a board game about the NYC energy grid
- Researched and compiled information about NYC sustainability events and posted it on the online event calendar
- Wrote reviews of climate change books

educations.schoolName: Macaulay Honors College at The City University of New York

volunteerExperiences.description:
An organization dedicated to raising awareness about environmental issues at Hunter College.
- Oversaw club meetings, budget, operations and activities
- Organized events to educate Hunter students on the environment including a clothing swap and a week-long eco-fair.
- Collaborated with other club members to submit grant proposals to school administration
